components.name: Primary button
components.description: Preview of the filled action; use Angular Material in the application.
components.css: .ds-primary { font: 600 0.95rem system-ui; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--sb-primary, #163d36); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; }.ds-primary:hover { background: var(--sb-primary-hover, #24564c); }.ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sb-primary, #163d36); outline-offset: 3px; }.ds-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Outlined action preview; production uses Material outlined buttons.
components.css: .ds-secondary { font: 500 0.95rem system-ui; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid #789488; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: var(--sb-primary, #163d36); cursor: pointer; }.ds-secondary:hover { background: #edf4ef; }.ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sb-primary, #163d36); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quantity field
components.description: Labeled measured quantity preview; production uses Material and Signal Forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; font: 500 0.85rem system-ui; color: var(--sb-ink, #152333); }.ds-input { font: 400 0.95rem system-ui; padding: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #789488; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: var(--sb-ink, #152333); caret-color: var(--sb-primary, #163d36); }.ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--sb-primary, #163d36); }.ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sb-primary, #163d36); outline-offset: 2px; }.ds-hint { color: var(--sb-muted, #526a60); font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Dark frame with lime active destination.
components.html: ProductsHome
components.css: .ds-nav { padding: 1rem; background: var(--sb-primary, #163d36); display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; }.ds-nav-link { padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 8px; font: 550 0.9rem system-ui; color: #d4e4dc; text-decoration: none; }.ds-nav-link:hover { background: #24564c; color: #fff; }.ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-active:hover { background: var(--sb-lime, #d6f86a); color: #163d36; }.ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d6f86a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Working surface
components.description: Flat task boundary with a hairline; avoid nested decorative cards.
components.html:
Stock movements

Review quantities and reasons in one working surface.
components.css: .ds-surface { padding: clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); border: 1px solid var(--sb-border, #dce7e1); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: var(--sb-ink, #152333); font-family: system-ui; }.ds-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; }.ds-copy { color: var(--sb-muted, #526a60); line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 0; }

components.name: Active status
components.description: Informational state label, not a button.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-block; padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; font: 400 0.8rem system-ui; }

narrative.overview:
Storeboard's approved identity is a calm, organized green workspace: a dark
navigation frame, light working surfaces, restrained lime accents, and clear
operational content. This refresh consolidates the accepted Storeboard extension
and supersedes the obsolete blue-only, single-centered-card baseline.

Optimize for owners and staff using the product between customer-facing tasks.
Make the next action, current balance, validation feedback, and recovery path easy
to find. Brand character comes from color, typography, spacing, and dependable
behavior rather than decorative components.
keyCharacteristics: Forest-green navigation and primary actions; lime for selected navigation.
Neutral working surfaces, thin dividers, and readable quantities.
Angular Material controls with app-specific shells and shared data components.
Romanian/English content and responsive, keyboard-accessible operation.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Reuse global `--sb-*` and `--mat-sys-*` roles in new styles. Adjust shared theme roles when a component needs a systematic change; do not target private Material DOM/classes.

rules.name: The Working Surface Rule
rules.body: Group by task, separate by whitespace or a divider, and reserve a decorated surface for a real working boundary.

dos: Do reuse semantic tokens and established Material/shared component APIs.
Do prioritize the operator's next task, current state, and recovery path.
Do show quantities with units and prices with their currency context.
Do verify mobile, keyboard, translated content, and async failure states.
Do distinguish observed implementation from forward guidance and known drift.
donts: Don't restore the superseded blue-only theme or fixed-width auth layout.
Don't clone bespoke controls or override private Material implementation classes.
Don't hide essential meaning in color, hover, an icon, or a tooltip alone.
Don't round stock for visual convenience or present services as physical stock.
Don't treat old literals, decorative overlines, or existing accessibility gaps as reusable rules.
